targets.rawSql: SELECT status, duration_seconds, started_at AS time FROM observability.grafana_training_status WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT promoted_model_version, dataset_version, completed_at AS time FROM observability.grafana_training_status WHERE promoted_model_version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT measured_at AS time, mae, mse, rmse, r2 FROM observability.grafana_model_metric_history WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND candidate_family = ANY(string_to_array('${family:csv}', ',')) ORDER BY measured_at
SELECT candidate_family, mae, mse, rmse, r2, eligible, promoted FROM observability.grafana_candidate_comparison WHERE training_run_id::text = '${training_run_id}' ORDER BY candidate_family
SELECT completed_at AS time, best_so_far_rmse, candidate_family AS metric FROM observability.grafana_optuna_convergence WHERE $__timeFilter(completed_at) ORDER BY completed_at
SELECT started_at AS time, status, training_run_id::text FROM observability.grafana_training_status WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at

SELECT window_started_at AS time, model_version, request_count, error_count, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, heartbeat_age_seconds FROM observability.grafana_inference_operations WHERE $__timeFilter(window_started_at) ORDER BY window_started_at
SELECT max(metric_age_seconds) AS metric_age_seconds FROM observability.grafana_training_status

list.name: training_run_id
list.query: SELECT training_run_id::text FROM observability.grafana_training_status ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

list.name: family
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT candidate_family FROM observability.grafana_candidate_comparison ORDER BY 1
